title: Volunteer
description: Volunteer at this Tucson urban farm and heritage garden. Help with planting, harvesting, and maintaining the garden grounds. Promote local food sovereignty and heritage agriculture.
requirements: Interest in gardening and food systems; ability to work outdoors in desert heat

title: Hospice Volunteer
description: Provide companionship and emotional support to hospice patients and their families. Visit patients, read aloud, assist family caregivers with respite care.
requirements: Must be in or near Tucson, AZ; complete hospice volunteer onboarding and orientation

title: Hospice Volunteer
hours_note: Direct patient care is typically a 1-2 hour commitment per week
description: Provide companionship and support to hospice patients and their families in the Tucson area. Light patient care and emotional support.
requirements: Complete hospice volunteer training; background check

title: Data Entry Volunteer
hours_note: 5-15 hours a week (or updating a minimum of 20 resources per week), for 3-6 months
description: Remote volunteer to increase access to life-affirming resources in the Bay Area, Los Angeles and Gainesville, FL. Data entry, resource updating, and community resource management.
requirements: 18+, basic computer and data entry skills, typing, proofreading, access to computer

title: Review and Translation Volunteer
hours_note: 2 hours a week for at least six months
description: Edit borrowers' loan stories in English, or translate them if you also know French, Portuguese, Russian or Spanish. Help make microfinance loans accessible to entrepreneurs worldwide.
requirements: English proficiency; additional languages a plus; 6-month commitment

title: Talking Book Library Volunteer
hours_note: Two to four hours once a week
description: Learn to visually inspect and repair digital cartridge machines that play talking books for visually impaired patrons. Remote volunteer opportunity with the Arizona State Library's Talking Book Program.
requirements: Mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, ability to learn inspection and repair procedures
